scope: Full source-to-English semantic comparison of the nine files listed below, including all sections, tables, conditions, statuses, numerical bounds, and limitations. This is not a review of all 226 documents.
method: Read all canonical and English content for the nine assigned files; compare meaning rather than relying on translation markers or heading counts.
AI and agent-policy files reviewed directly; the four Sound Behavior files were fully compared by nested read-only reviewer /root/v1_english_docs/review_sound_ai/sound_review.
Compute SHA-256 from actual file bytes and validate every English source marker against the actual canonical path and source SHA.
Compare fenced code blocks verbatim with line endings normalized; code fences are intentionally not translated.
Treat source-relative links as pending parent rewrite, excluded from this semantic review.
